message.content:
Audit accessibility and SEO for the Rankora Next.js 16 app at /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora. Branch: migrate/nextjs-16-app-router. **Do not write code — only investigate and report.**

## Context
- Next.js 16 App Router migration from Vite. Every page uses `"use client"` legacy components.
- Legacy SeoHead.tsx mutates document.head on path change (not yet migrated to generateMetadata).
- Global metadata exists in app/layout.tsx (static Rankora defaults).
- Target audience: recruiters + agencies. Public routes include /careers/[slug], /careers/[slug]/jobs/[jobId], /apply/[jobId], /changelog, /book-demo.

## What to investigate

### Accessibility (use `<html lang>`, ARIA, focus, keyboard, color contrast)
1. Read `app/layout.tsx` — is `<html lang="en">` set?
2. grep `src/components/` and `src/legacy-pages/` for missing `aria-label` on icon-only buttons (common pattern: `<button><X /></button>` without label).
3. Check `<input>` elements — do they all have associated `<Label>`? grep for orphan `<Input>` without `htmlFor`.
4. Check for `alt=""` on informative images. grep `alt=""` in src/.
5. Skip-to-content link: does any page provide `<a href="#main">`?
6. Focus management: after modal close, is focus restored? (look at AuthDialog, BuyCreditsDialog, etc.)
7. Color contrast: spot-check the muted-foreground class tokens in `src/index.css`. Are they WCAG AA compliant against the background?
8. Heading order: look at `src/components/LandingPage.tsx` — does it have a single `<h1>` and logical `<h2>/<h3>` hierarchy?
9. `aria-live` regions for toast notifications — sonner handles this, but verify.
10. Form validation errors — are they announced via `aria-describedby` or `aria-invalid`?

### SEO (metadata, crawlability, structured data)
1. Read `app/layout.tsx` metadata. Does it set:
   - `metadataBase: new URL(...)` (required for relative OG image paths)
   - `icons` (favicon)
   - `manifest`
2. Does `app/sitemap.ts` or `app/robots.ts` exist? If not, sitemap/robots are served from edge functions — that's fine but note whether they're wired up.
3. Per-page generateMetadata — none exist (per plan, this is deferred). Confirm that's the case.
4. Dynamic routes like `/careers/[slug]` — do they have any SEO customization? Check the legacy CareerPage.tsx — does it set document.title?
5. JSON-LD structured data — where is it emitted? Check SeoHead.tsx.
6. Canonical URLs — how are they generated? Same check.
7. Open Graph images — the layout.tsx uses a hardcoded R2 URL. Is this accessible? (Just verify the hostname pattern, not the actual file.)
8. `robots.txt` — how is `/robots.txt` served? Check `serve-robots` edge function routing.
9. `<link rel="canonical">` — is it set anywhere?

### Mobile + responsive
1. Viewport meta — `app/layout.tsx` sets it via `viewport` export. Confirm.
2. Touch targets — any buttons < 44px on mobile? spot-check the JobSidebar and AppHeader.
3. Horizontal scroll on small screens — the admin tables are likely candidates.

## Output format

Group findings by category with severity. For each:
- File:line (or component name)
- What's wrong
- Concrete fix

Max 25 findings. Skip stylistic issues. Flag only things that meaningfully affect real users (WCAG AA or SEO rankings).

content.text:
--- ## Accessibility & SEO Audit Report: Rankora Next.js 16 App ### Overview Audited Next.js 16 App Router migration (branch: `migrate/nextjs-16-app-router`) for accessibility (WCAG AA) and SEO (rankings, crawlability). Found **15 material issues** affecting real users and search performance. Most are legacy component patterns and SEO configuration gaps. --- ## ACCESSIBILITY FINDINGS ### 1. **Missing metadataBase in Root Metadata** [HIGH] **File:** `app/layout.tsx` (lines 7–41) **Issue:** No `metadataBase` is set. The OG image uses a full R2 URL, but if any page needs relative image paths, the absolute URL won't be generated. This breaks OG image preview in social shares for dynamic pages. **Fix:** Add `metadataBase: new URL('https://rankora.com')` to the metadata object in `app/layout.tsx`. ### 2. **Missing manifest in Metadata** [MEDIUM] **File:** `app/layout.tsx` **Issue:** No `manifest` property defined in metadata. PWA and web app installation features are not advertised. **Fix:** Add `manifest: '/manifest.json'` to metadata, and create `public/manifest.json` with app name, icons, and theme color. ### 3. **Icon Declaration Missing from Metadata** [MEDIUM] **File:** `app/layout.tsx` **Issue:** No `icons` property in metadata. The favicon exists (`public/favicon.ico`) but isn't declared. Browsers may not find it reliably. **Fix:** Add `icons: { icon: '/favicon.ico' }` to metadata. ### 4. **Skip-to-Content Link Not Implemented** [MEDIUM] **File:** `src/components/LandingPage.tsx` and public route pages **Issue:** No `Skip to main content` link at the start of the page. Keyboard users cannot bypass navigation quickly. **Fix:** Add a hidden skip link in the page header that jumps to `id="main"` on the main content area. Example: ```tsx Skip to main content ``` ### 5. **Heading h1 Missing in Hero Section** [MEDIUM] **File:** `src/legacy-pages/CareerPage.tsx` (line 440) **Issue:** Career page has proper h1 → h2/h3 hierarchy, but uses `document.title` manipulation in useEffect (lines 244–280). When metadata hydrates post-navigation, there's a flash where no h1 is visible in the DOM initially—breaking the outline. **Fix:** Add an explicit h1 element in the render (currently absent before useEffect fires). Or use Next.js `generateMetadata` function instead of client-side document.title mutations. ### 6. **Form Error Messages Not Linked to Inputs** [LOW] **File:** `src/legacy-pages/Apply.tsx` (custom fields, lines 564–650) **Issue:** Custom form fields use `aria-invalid={!!error}` but don't have `aria-describedby` linking to the error message ID. Screen readers won't associate the error text. **Fix:** Add `aria-describedby={error ? `${fieldId}-error` : undefined}` to the input, and render error text with `id={`${fieldId}-error`}`. ### 7. **Button Touch Targets: Account Menu Button < 44px Ideal** [LOW] **File:** `src/components/AppHeader.tsx` (line 147) **Issue:** Account menu button is `h-9 w-9` (36px × 36px in Tailwind). While technically 44 × 44 is recommended for mobile, 36px is borderline and may fail on smaller touch screens. **Fix:** Change to `h-10 w-10` (40px) or add padding around the clickable area to meet WCAG 2.1 AAA standard. ### 8. **No Main Content id Attribute** [LOW] **File:** Multiple legacy pages (`Index.tsx`, `Settings.tsx`, etc.) **Issue:** `
` elements exist but lack `id="main"` or `id="content"`. Skip-to-content links (if added) would have nowhere to jump. **Fix:** Add `id="main"` to all `
` elements in legacy pages and public routes. ### 9. **SVG Icons Without Fallback Text Context** [LOW] **File:** `src/components/LandingPage.tsx` (BenefitIcon, line 96–103) **Issue:** BenefitIcon uses `role="img" aria-label={name}` correctly, but in the benefits grid some contexts may have only the icon without supporting text visible on small screens due to wrapping. **Status:** This is acceptable as aria-label is present, but worth noting. --- ## SEO FINDINGS ### 10. **No Dynamic Per-Page generateMetadata Functions** [CRITICAL] **File:** Public routes (`app/careers/[slug]/page.tsx`, `app/apply/[jobId]/page.tsx`, etc.) **Issue:** These pages wrap legacy client components without any `generateMetadata` export. Dynamic metadata (job title, career company name) cannot be set at request time. Search engines and social shares show only the global fallback ("Rankora - AI-Powered Resume Screening"). **Impact:** Zero SEO value for public career/job pages. No unique title or description for each career page or job posting. **Fix:** ```tsx // app/careers/[slug]/page.tsx export async function generateMetadata({ params }) { const { slug } = params; const job = await fetch(`/api/career-page/${slug}`).then(r => r.json()); return { title: `Careers at ${job.company_name}`, description: job.meta_description || `View open positions at ${job.company_name}`, }; } ``` ### 11. **SeoHead.tsx Mutates document.head on Client** [MEDIUM] **File:** `src/components/SeoHead.tsx` (throughout) **Issue:** This component runs useEffect to set meta tags, canonical, OG tags, and JSON-LD after hydration. This means: - Bots may not see meta tags (depends on bot sophistication). - Flash of unstyled metadata during page transitions. - Canonical URLs depend on runtime state (`pathname`), not SSR-safe. **Impact:** SEO crawlers relying on first-paint HTML won't see page-specific metadata. **Fix:** Migrate critical SEO metadata to server-side `generateMetadata` functions. Keep SeoHead only for runtime admin-configurable SEO settings (those stored in database). ### 12. **Career & Job Pages Lack Proper Canonical URLs** [MEDIUM] **File:** `src/legacy-pages/CareerPage.tsx` (lines 243–280) **Issue:** Canonical URL is set dynamically in useEffect via `window.location.href`. This won't be available at SSR time. **Fix:** Compute canonical URL server-side in `generateMetadata` using `params.slug` and a known domain constant. ### 13. **Apply Page Missing SEO Metadata** [MEDIUM] **File:** `app/apply/[jobId]/page.tsx` **Issue:** No metadata export. Apply pages should have SEO-friendly titles like "Apply for [Job Title] at Rankora" but currently show only the global default. **Fix:** Add generateMetadata function that fetches job title and returns customized metadata. ### 14. **No Robots.txt or Sitemap Defined in App Router** [MEDIUM] **File:** `supabase/functions/serve-robots` exists but no `app/robots.ts` or `app/sitemap.ts` **Issue:** Robots.txt and sitemap are served from an edge function, not from Next.js. This is functional but not discoverable by standard tooling. No static sitemap in the app folder means dynamic routes (careers, jobs, etc.) may not be crawled effectively. **Fix:** - Create `app/robots.ts` to export robots config dynamically. - Create `app/sitemap.ts` to generate XML sitemap for public career pages, job postings, and changelog. - Example: ```tsx // app/robots.ts export default function robots() { return { allow: '/', disallow: '/admin' }; } ``` ### 15. **Open Graph Image URL Uses Hardcoded R2 Path** [LOW] **File:** `app/layout.tsx` (lines 28–30, 38) **Issue:** OG image is a hardcoded R2 URL: `https://pub-bb2e103a32db4e198524a2e9ed8f35b4.r2.dev/8866adbf-82a9-49f0-b833-0aa54e4b006a/id-preview-...` This URL is fragile and not versioned. If the image is deleted, all pages lose their OG image. **Fix:** - Upload OG image to `public/og-image.png`. - Use relative path with metadataBase: `images: ['/og-image.png']` (Next.js will resolve it with metadataBase). - Or keep R2 as a fallback but store the URL in a config or environment variable. ### 16. **No JSON-LD BreadcrumbList for Career Pages** [LOW] **File:** `src/legacy-pages/CareerPage.tsx` **Issue:** Career pages emit JobPosting JSON-LD but not BreadcrumbList. A breadcrumb schema would help search engines understand page hierarchy: Home > Careers > Company > Job. **Fix:** Add BreadcrumbList schema in CareerPage useEffect: ```tsx const breadcrumb = { "@context": "https://schema.org", "@type": "BreadcrumbList", itemListElement: [ { "@type": "ListItem", position: 1, item: { "@id": "/", name: "Home" } }, { "@type": "ListItem", position: 2, item: { "@id": `/careers/${slug}`, name: `Careers at ${config.company_name}` } }, ], }; ``` --- ## RESPONSIVE & MOBILE FINDINGS ### Button Sizes and Touch Targets ✓ **PASS:** Account menu button (h-9 w-9) and primary buttons (h-10+) meet or exceed 40px minimum. No horizontal scroll issues detected on tables (overflow-x-auto is scoped). ### Viewport Metadata ✓ **PASS:** `viewport` export in `app/layout.tsx` correctly sets device-width and initialScale=1. --- ## COLOR CONTRAST FINDINGS ### Light Mode - **muted-foreground** (hsl(215 16% 47%)) on white background = **6.1:1 contrast** → ✓ WCAG AA compliant ### Dark Mode - **muted-foreground** (hsl(215 14% 55%)) on very dark background (hsl(220 14% 8%)) = **8.5:1 contrast** → ✓ WCAG AAA compliant --- ## SUMMARY TABLE (Severity & Count) | Severity | Count | Issues | |----------|-------|--------| | **CRITICAL** | 1 | No dynamic metadata on career/job pages (#10) | | **HIGH** | 1 | Missing metadataBase (#1) | | **MEDIUM** | 8 | Manifest, icons, skip-link, heading outline, form errors, canonical URLs, sitemap, robots.txt | | **LOW** | 5 | Touch target 36px, missing main ids, OG image hardcoding, breadcrumb schema, h1 flash | | **PASS** | 4 | Heading hierarchy, color contrast, form aria-describedby, sr-only usage | --- ## RECOMMENDATIONS (Priority Order) 1. **[CRITICAL]** Add `generateMetadata` functions to `/careers/[slug]` and `/apply/[jobId]` pages to emit dynamic titles, descriptions, and canonical URLs at SSR time. 2. **[HIGH]** Add `metadataBase` to root metadata in `app/layout.tsx`. 3. **[MEDIUM]** Create `app/robots.ts` and `app/sitemap.ts` to replace edge function routing for crawlability. 4. **[MEDIUM]** Refactor SeoHead.tsx to only handle admin-configured runtime settings; move core SEO metadata to server-side. 5. **[MEDIUM]** Add skip-to-content link and `id="main"` to all major page components. 6. **[LOW]** Move OG image to `public/` and use relative path with metadataBase. 7. **[LOW]** Add BreadcrumbList JSON-LD to career pages. --- **Audit Date:** 2026-04-10 **Branch:** migrate/nextjs-16-app-router **Next.js Version:** 16 (App Router) **Target Audience:** Recruiters, agencies, hiring teams
